title: Evaluating Artificial Intelligence Through a Christian Understanding of Human Flourishing

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model responses to single-turn prompts about human flourishing against a pluralistic baseline (FAI-G-ST) versus a specifically Christian theological evaluation framework (FAI-C-ST) using LLM-as-a-judge personas.

Assessing the implicit normative and moral commitments in LLM outputs to detect defaults toward 'Procedural Secularism', therapeutic consensus, and expressive individualism over explicit metaphysical or teleological frameworks.
